d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from New Zealand vs Belgium in Group G of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Belgium ran riot in a 6-0 group stage win at Aspire Zone in Doha as Matteo Soria struck twice and Preben Blondeel, Tinus Moorthamer, Kiyan Achahbar and Jelle Driessen were also on target. Belgium finish second in Group G to reach the Round of 32, while New Zealand exit the tournament.
